svg.title: The executable surface
svg.desc:
Walk the contract from inputs to effects. authenticate: Validate credential; derive registered principal; Trusted transport, not user body identity. check / authorize: Require current scope and operation grant; Recheck cached replay and sensitive owner commits. route: Validate scope and route owner; Only owner polls/acks; worker route checked. Private selection / approval: Bind profile, placement and exact eligible result; Descriptor consistency is separate from permission. Operation groups on this slide are not a new coverage denominator. The evidence ledger distinguishes new operations from inherited dependencies. Supporting internal helpers are labelled as seams and are not advertised remote services.
Evidence and implementation: [policy.py](https://github.com/machieke/fusion-module-interfaces/blob/494df69a1ac401c3d3b2cf79dbfde07f74b5e277/fusion/policy.py), [private.py](https://github.com/machieke/fusion-module-interfaces/blob/494df69a1ac401c3d3b2cf79dbfde07f74b5e277/fusion/private.py), [service.py](https://github.com/machieke/fusion-module-interfaces/blob/494df69a1ac401c3d3b2cf79dbfde07f74b5e277/fusion/service.py), [test_m11.py](https://github.com/machieke/fusion-module-interfaces/blob/494df69a1ac401c3d3b2cf79dbfde07f74b5e277/tests/test_m11.py), [test_m2.py](https://github.com/machieke/fusion-module-interfaces/blob/494df69a1ac401c3d3b2cf79dbfde07f74b5e277/tests/test_m2.py), [test_m5_integration.py](https://github.com/machieke/fusion-module-interfaces/blob/494df69a1ac401c3d3b2cf79dbfde07f74b5e277/integration/hive/test_m5_integration.py), [m1_1-evidence.md](https://github.com/machieke/fusion-module-interfaces/blob/494df69a1ac401c3d3b2cf79dbfde07f74b5e277/docs/module-interfaces/m1_1-evidence.md).
Scope: repository snapshot 494df69a1ac401c3d3b2cf79dbfde07f74b5e277; tested M5 runtime bfb0ec8856c932dc2bcbc05b8949c957da8d72cd. Historical observations keep their own milestone source. This deck build runs no runtime or benchmark. Future directions and proposed benchmark designs are not implemented work or measured results.
svg.text: These operations and implementation seams define the supported scope; versions and profiles remain explicit.
Trusted local host/operator; directory placement is not encryption or administrator secrecy.
